page.overview:
Who is Miller?

Miller was an Asset Containment Unit trooper at Jurassic World on Isla Nublar during the Jurassic World Incident.

After the Indominus rex broke out, Miller and his team searched for the dinosaur. However, they were ambushed and several members were killed when trying to subdue it. A fellow trooper was injured during the battle and had to be dragged to safety by Austin and another trooper, several other troopers began running away through the jungle on the right side. Deciding to take action, Miller attemped to cover them with his shotgun and gave them enough time to escape from the Indominus. Unfortunately the dinosaur was immune to the shots and devoured him whole.
